title: rottlera moluccana
intro: Rottlera moluccana, commonly known as the Moluccana Rottlera, is a plant species native to the Molucca Islands in Indonesia. It is a shrub-like plant with various medicinal and therapeutic properties. The health benefits of Rottlera moluccana include its ability to lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels, as well as its potential to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues such as asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
